transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, what finally scared me into coming in is that... after I eat too much, I’ve been making myself throw up in the bathroom. I just do it so I won’t gain weight. But it’s gotten to the point where it isn’t just a one-time mistake anymore, and I realized I needed to talk to someone about it.
How often have you been making yourself throw up after eating, and does it happen only after eating too much or in other situations as well?

Well, for at least the past several months, I'd say it’s been happening most weeks. It really just happens after I have one of those... secret eating spells where I eat way too much, and then I go make myself sick afterward. I can’t honestly call it occasional anymore.
Can you describe what happens during these 'secret eating spells'? Do you feel like you’re eating a very large amount of food in a short period of time and can’t stop yourself?

Yes, that's exactly how it feels. Like... after a bridge night, or maybe when I get off a late shift at the store, I might come home and just start eating. I'll have leftover casserole, the cookies I baked, crackers, ice cream... just eating it all in one sitting. 

And I do feel like I can't stop once I get going. It's just so much more food than I’d ever put on a plate in front of anyone.
During these eating spells, do you feel like you lose control over how much you eat, like you can’t stop eating once you start?

Yes, I do. Once I start during those times, it feels like I’m just on automatic. I'll be standing there thinking I should really stop before my husband notices what I'm doing, but... I just keep reaching for one more thing anyway. The control just isn't there.
